lina: Proposal: run cohort migration windows to reduce surprise load and give customers clear opt-in lanes. My suggested cadence: 3-week runway per cohort, with a 72h staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) per region.

lina: Acceptance gates (must pass all before next stage): perf p95 regression <= 20%, avg cost delta <= +15%, eval-quality drift <= 5% on customer-specific prompt-set. If any gate trips, auto-roll back to previous stage and open a postmortem.

ben: For Dedicated customers we can’t just switch them without commit — how do pins and soft-fallbacks work here?

lina: Good call. For Dedicated/Private we’ll offer a soft-pin TTL of 14 days; customers get a one-click rollback in Console. For committed capacity we’ll schedule cohort during their reserved maintenance windows.

eli: Engineering question: what are the automated rollback triggers? Who owns the signal? I want exact metric names so runtime can emit alerts.

kat: From ML side we need per-customer eval sets (sampled from recent queries) — we should run a quick eval job as part of canary stage. If model fails any critical rubric, stop rollout. Also watch embed-schema/response-shape diffs.

jess_cs: From CS: customers want a 7-day heads-up + an explicit opt-in for non-default migrations. Also request a human review step for top-10 accounts.

ops-bot: Canary created: cohort/2026-07-17-region-eu (ID: c-cohort-7721). Canary window starts 2026-07-21T00:00Z.

tariq: Suggest we codify this into a lightweight playbook: 1) canary dataset + eval job, 2) perf/cost smoke tests, 3) customer comms + opt-in, 4) staged rollout with telemetry gates, 5) rollback and RCA template. I can draft a one-pager.

ben: Also need a quick cost delta calc for each cohort: estimate delta in tokens/sec and GPU-hours. Can infra help provide expected extra capacity numbers per cohort size?

lina: Action items: 
- tariq -> 1-pager playbook (due Tue)
- eli -> list of metric names + alert thresholds for runtime (due Mon)
- kat -> eval job template + per-customer sampling rules (due Mon)
- ops -> capacity estimate for cohort sizes 10/100/1000 (due Wed)
- jess_cs -> comms template and opt-in flow copy (due Tue)

lina: We’ll run a small pilot cohort next month with two mid-market customers and one enterprise (soft-pin). Plan to debrief after pilot with data to finalize the migration SLA. :thumbsup:

ben: ack

eli: ack

kat: ack

jess_cs: ack
